content: AI ticket triage failure modes: over-automation without escalation (silent failures on exceptional cases with no human watching), accuracy decay (95% at launch drifting to 60% by 90 days without feedback loop/retraining on human corrections), inconsistent classification breaking downstream routing (severity mistagged sends critical issues to wrong/junior queue), rule-based brittleness (keyword rules break on language/phrasing drift). Confidence threshold guidance: below ~90% intent-classification confidence, human agents keep correcting tags. Red flag: >20% of tickets reassigned more than twice indicates routing logic is failing.
